method.advance: The ordered check must add four strict report locations across both generators, including at least two gains beyond each same-model control. Allow at most one extra flagged genuine work per held cohort and require 90% held edited-report coverage. No authorship confidence is produced.
method.decision: Fit class- and work-balanced logistic heads with fixed ridge penalty. Select one top native sentence strictly above the second-highest separate ordinary work maximum. Compare with the current primary proxy's first six native three-sentence contexts at the original research point.
method.measurement: Read the exact submitted excerpt once with a pinned base causal model. Compare distributional features, those plus ordered dynamics, and the same dynamics after a fixed within-sentence permutation. Subtract the per-excerpt feature median as an extra input for each feature.
method.source: Fit on 24 prior matched GAO works, and set the point on a separate 21 genuine journal works. Hold out 20 new GAO works selected by the frozen matched-polish intake after excluding both older banks. Report previously exposed eLife, forum and USWDS controls separately.
